parse_size_string: parse a size string like 128M or 2G into bytes using nccl-tests compatible parsing
parse_rank_list: parse a rank list string with comma separated values or colon delimited ranges into a list of ints
compute_algorithmic_bandwidth: compute algorithmic bandwidth in GBps and average iteration time from elapsed time and data size
read_comms_env_vars: read distributed training environment variables like world size and rank from MPI SLURM or OMPI env vars
map_collective_name: map creative collective communication names like alltoall or allreduce to standardized internal names
